# The same 10.00 USD fee drawn from the purchase's cost basis, in a
# transaction stated in USD rather than in the book's own currency.
#
# Nothing in it says what the sale fetched in CAD — both splits are USD — so
# `a_sale_valued_against_another_cost` declines to answer for it, which is
# deliberate: a transaction between two foreign currencies states its values in
# neither. What that costs is that this disposal cannot hold the basis above it
# to the cost it was valued against.
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Fees:USD
	type: Expense
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-02-12 * "A 10 USD fee, stated in USD"
	currency.mnemonic: "USD"
	Assets:Bank:USD -10.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		cost_basis_split_guid: "{basis}"
	Expenses:Fees:USD 10.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
